GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (9 June 46) IPS
(SCAPIN - 1010)
APO 500
9 June 1946
MEMORANDUM TO : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Release of OKAWA Shumei from Sugamo Prison.
It is directed that the Imperial Japanese Government contact the Commanding Officer of Sugamo Prison, who will deliver one OKAWA Shumei, who is suffering from a venereal disease. It is further directed that he be committed to a Japanese hospital for treatment and security. Upon completion of the treatment, a report of the results of said treatment will be rendered to the International Prosecution Section, War Ministry Building, Tokyo.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
